title: NounWatch
tagline: On-chain data aggregator that turns long youtube videos of crypto influencers into AI summarized insights quick to read & visualize.

prizes.title: Build Data Economies & Tools Together with Filecoin

description:
This app comes from our personal need to follow financial content creator without passing hours every morning.

NounWatch is a webapp which allow users to copy/paste a youtube Url in a search bar and see the result. Our AI will extract some insights from the script of the video. Since the tool target financial data to make investment decisions, the extracted data will be: Mentioned Coins, Sentitiment (From Very Bearish to very Bullish), Technical and Fundamental Analysis key bullet points. We thought about adding more but for now these are the important ones. 

The user visualize a summary made by text, graphics and an illustration of a Nouns according that expresses the sentiment of the content.

An important point is that the user can verify the data from the youtube transcript and the AI's analysis.
how_its_made:
- a python script is used to get the transcript offchain
- the transcript is passed to Galadriel AI, and L1 AI oracle leveraging openai or other LLM in the backend
- the contract creates a proof of computation (from a TEE) and put the result onchain
- both the transcript and the analysis are saved on filecoin
- the react frontend display the newly created datas
